records.title: U.S. Air Force Experience in Hypobaric Osteonecrosis
records.author: Allen TH, Davis JC, Hodgson CJ
records.locator: Printed p. 17 (PDF p. 33), Ratnoff paragraph; p. 18, References

observations.note: Both hips were radiographed in 21 people after repeated simulated exposures at 35000 and 40000 ft. The report found no changes matching those described in caisson workers. Two equivocal findings occurred in people with no known history of bends. The acute DCS numerator, exposure count and follow-up interval are unavailable.

records.note: Secondary reporting of Ratnoff's screening result. The chapter also summarizes the two separately published osteonecrosis cases and the Hodgson operator survey. These accounts do not add cases or a denominator.

records.title: The Absence of Roentgenographically Demonstrable Bony Changes at the Hip Joint in Subjects Exposed to Simulated High Altitude
records.author: Ratnoff OD
records.institution: U.S. Army Air Forces School of Aviation Medicine, Randolph Field, Texas
records.locator: Allen et al., workshop reference list p. 18 and Hodgson et al. 1968 p. 421 ref. 3
records.note: The available URLs document the citation. The original report was not recovered. Hodgson et al. 1968 p. 417 corroborates 21 people and no lesions, and describes 35000 ft and 5 to 100 hours. The 1974 workshop additionally describes 40000 ft and uses a different duration summary. The observation takes the explicit radiographic pattern and observations of equivocal findings from the workshop, with no attempt to harmonize duration.
